instruction.text: Navigate through the extreme mixed street, sharing space with up to 11 people and 4 vehicles, with others crossing your path. Keep a safe distance from others and move at a pace that suits the conditions.

action_space.convention: Grounded ego-motion: forward/lateral/yaw recovered by motion-field solve on agent-masked static pixels, metric-scaled by depth. velocity_mps=measured horizontal speed; yaw_rate_dps=measured angular velocity; (forward,lateral,yaw) = holonomic command. weight<1 = low solve-confidence / artifact frame.
